scope: One-way live write-reservation retention, actual macOS source development with controlled close-fault scheduling

independent_review.decision: approved within descriptor-backed reservation retention source scope

preserved: Only a complete live descriptor-backed owner can select one-way retention; saved markers or state cannot reconstruct ownership
Retention is selected before currentness checks so an observed conflict retains every other marker and created parent
Normal and failed exit retain all controls, invalidate the owner and attempt every descriptor close without retrying retired descriptor numbers

A single release interruption is preserved exactly; mixed failures remain bounded groups, OS-only failures retain typed cleanup diagnostics and original causes, and body/release errors both stay visible
Default cleanup branch and shared lock/filesystem/Git helpers and existing critical marker tests remain unchanged
Actual separate-process native mutex acquisition proves successful close releases the kernel lock while the retained token remains a blocker to another reservation owner
causal_repairs: Controlled KeyboardInterrupt after first actual close formerly left another owned descriptor open and unattempted
A body error plus mixed release interruptions formerly omitted later close diagnostics; both maintained regressions fail exact predecessor bytes and pass the repair
limits: Close failure may have ambiguous native outcome; attempts are guaranteed by the reviewed loop, successful close is not manufactured or inferred, and retired numbers are not retried

Existing generic acquisition still creates public controls before their identities can be journaled; the layout owner must stage known nodes privately and persist exact intent before any public effect
Retention does not journal acquisition, prove project/Git/control roles, authorize source effects, grant future recovery/deletion rights or enable public apply
remaining: Actual project/conversion/Git/control authority and canonical reservation owner with staged durable acquisition
Fresh acknowledged recovery with complete source/endpoint custody and foreign-state preservation
Native Windows durability and actual platform, installed, full-source, integration and exact-head/main qualification
All structural renewal, initial plain/root/custom placement, relocation and genuine baseline/parity/lock/readmission/receipt renewal acceptance
